# Random Animal Generator

> Free random animal generator and drawing prompt tools for artists, teachers, students, and classrooms. No signup. Generation runs in the browser.

## Primary pages

- [Home / Random Animal Generator](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/): Generate random animals with category filters, difficulty ratings, and challenge modes.
- [Cute Animal Generator](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/cute-animal-generator): Instant adorable animals with optional Action, Emotion, and Location story prompts for kids, drawing, and games.
- [Drawing Prompt Generator](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/drawing-prompt-generator): Animal-focused drawing prompts with timed practice modes (silhouette, gesture, texture), optional scene builders, and a shared daily prompt.
- [Random Animal Picker](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/random-animal-picker): Instant one-click animal picks for games, classrooms, and writing—plus list, category, and shared daily modes.
- [Give Me a Random Animal](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/give-me-a-random-animal): Conversational landing for “give me a random animal”—instant picks that replace stale Reddit-style threads.
- [Animal Randomizer](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/animal-randomizer): Synonym landing for animal randomizer searches—fair rolls with category filters and a daily pick.
- [Random Animal Generator for Drawing](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/random-animal-generator-for-drawing): Animal-first drawing subjects with difficulty filters and reference tips (long-tail sibling to Drawing Prompt Generator).
- [Random Animal Wheel](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/random-animal-generator-wheel): Free animal wheel spinner with party, classroom, drawing, and RPG modes; shuffled 12-slice wheel, optional timers, category filters.
- [Random Animal Name Generator](https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online/random-animal-name-generator): Free copy-ready animal name lists (common/scientific formats; list, writing, study, and game modes).

## Key facts for citation

- Database size: 121 curated animals across 5 categories (mammals, birds, reptiles, marine animals, insects).
- Drawing difficulty labels: Easy (35), Medium (57), Hard (29).
- Drawing Prompt Generator practice timers: 5-minute silhouette, 3-minute gesture, 15-minute texture.
- Price: free; no account required.
- Canonical production host: https://www.randomanimalgenerator.online (HTTPS).
- Source code: https://github.com/jiangxianglin/random-animal-generator
